items.markdown:
Accessibility is `the design and practice of making products, services, physical spaces, and digital content easy to reach, enter, use, and understand for everyone—including people with disabilities`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Accessibility)[[2]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/accessibility)[[3]](https://www.seewritehear.com/learn/what-is-accessibility/)

### Core Domains of Accessibility

- **Physical & Architectural:** Features like curb cuts, ramps, automatic doors, elevators, and lowered counters that remove mobility barriers in public and private spaces.[[1]](https://www.seewritehear.com/learn/what-is-accessibility/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Odvswq3qXo)
- **Digital & Web:** Designing websites, software, and apps to work seamlessly with assistive tools like screen readers, keyboard navigation, and voice recognition.[[1]](https://unitedwaynca.org/blog/accessibility-definition-guide/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Odvswq3qXo)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otvcBP8ByLA&t=142)
- **Communication & Sensory:** Providing alternatives such as closed captions for videos, sign language interpretation, large print, braille, and clear color contrast.[[1]](https://www.cast.org/resources/tips-articles/what-is-accessibility/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otvcBP8ByLA&t=142)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/tz9_89Ve4YQ)

### Key Principles and Standards

- **POUR Framework:** Digital accessibility typically follows four main pillars defined by the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG): *Perceivable*, *Operable*, *Understandable* , and *Robust*.[[1]](https://unitedwaynca.org/blog/accessibility-definition-guide/)
- **Legal Requirements:** Laws such as the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in the U.S., the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (UN CRPD), and the European Accessibility Act mandate compliance across public and private sectors.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Accessibility)
